The sixth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series is named the {{nihongo|'''Arrancar: The Arrival arc'''|破面・出現篇|Arankaru Shutsugen Hen}}. In the English adaptation of the anime released by [[Viz Media]], the title of the season is translated as '''The Arrancar'''.<ref name="amazonseason6">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0036BDQH4|title=Amazon.com: Bleach, Vol. 27: Bleach: Movies & TV|website=Amazon|access-date=2010-12-05}}</ref> The episodes are directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ BLEACH =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-04-07}}</ref> The season adapts [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' [[manga]] series from the rest of the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol21|21st]] volume to the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol26|26th]] volume (chapters 183–229), with the exception of episodes 128–131 ([[Filler (media)|filler]]). The episodes' plot follows the burgeoning war between the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach|Soul Reapers]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Arrancar|Arrancars]], led by the traitorous former Soul Reaper [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Captain|captain]] [[Sousuke Aizen]].  

The season aired on [[TV Tokyo]] from January to June 2007.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes10/|title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (109-120)|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-10-04|archive-date=2012-10-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121020181754/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes10/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes11/|title=List of ''Bleach'' episode titles (121-131)|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=2009-10-04|archive-date=2014-10-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141014205918/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes11/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The English adaptation of the ''Bleach'' anime is licensed by [[Viz Media]],<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2006-03-15/viz-officially-announces-bleach-anime|title=Viz Officially Announces Bleach Anime|date=2006-03-15|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=2009-04-13}}</ref> and aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] in the United States from April to July 2009.<ref name="firstseasonsix"/><ref name="secondseasonsix"/> 

Five DVD compilations, each containing four episodes of the season, were released by [[Aniplex]] between June 27 and October 24, 2007.<ref name="StudioPierrotDVD1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000PMFSEG/|title=BLEACH 破面·出現篇1|language=ja|access-date=2009-12-31}}</ref><ref name="AmazonJPDVD5">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000VNGVZO|title=BLEACH 破面(アランカル)·出現篇 5|language=ja|access-date=2008-09-25}}</ref> Viz Media released the season in five DVD volumes from April 20 to August 24, 2010.<ref name="amazonseason6"/><ref name="VizDVD31">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8604 
 |title=Bleach, Vol. 31 (DVD) 
 |publisher=[[Viz Media]] 
 |access-date=2010-05-18 
 |url-status=dead 
 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101201203240/http://viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8604 
 |archive-date=2010-12-01 
}}</ref> It was also collected in two DVD boxes on September 28 and December 21, 2010, with the latter including the first two episodes of season 7.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B003R3JNQY/ |title=Bleach Uncut Box Set 6|website=Amazon|date=28 September 2010|access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0041QSZ7O/ |title=Bleach Uncut Box Set 7|website=Amazon|access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref> [[Manga Entertainment]] published the season in DVD volumes in the United Kingdom with the first released on April 11  and the second is on June 13, 2011.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B004L9IDAK/|title=Bleach - Series 6 Vol.1|website=Amazon UK|access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B004L9IDAU/|title=Bleach - Series 6 Vol.2|website=Amazon UK|access-date=2011-04-14}}</ref> A DVD box followed it on September 26, 2011.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B005DE1G3I/|title=Bleach - Complete Series 6 DVD|website=Amazon UK|access-date=2011-10-04}}</ref>

The episodes use four pieces of [[theme music]]: two opening themes and two ending themes. The opening themes are [[Yui (singer)|Yui]]'s "[[Rolling Star]]", used for the first eleven episodes,<ref name="music1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070202003657/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2007-02-02|language=ja}}</ref> and the remainder of the episodes feature "Alones" by [[Aqua Timez]].<ref name="music2">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=2009-04-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070510002823/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2007-05-10|language=ja}}</ref> The ending themes are [[Mai Hoshimura]]'s {{nihongo|"Sakura Biyori"|桜日和||"Cherry Blossom Weather"}}, used until episode 120,<ref name="music1" /> and {{nihongo|"Tsumasaki"|爪先||"Tiptoe"}} by [[Oreskaband]], used in the remainder of the episodes.<ref name="music2" />

{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 110
| EpisodeNumber2  = 1
| Title           = Reopening of the Substitute Business! The Terrifying Transfer Student
| TranslitTitle   = Daikōgyō Saikai! Kyōfu no Tenkōsei
| NativeTitle     = 代行業再開！恐怖の転校生
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Hiroaki Nishimura
| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|1|10}}
| AltDate         = April 19, 2009
| ShortSummary    = In [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Hueco Mundo]], the [[List of hollows in Bleach#hollow|hollow]] [[List of hollows in Bleach#Grand Fisher|Grand Fisher]] transforms into an imperfect [[List of hollows in Bleach#arrancar|arrancar]] and enters the real world. Meanwhile, [[List of Bleach characters#Shinji Hirako|Shinji Hirako]] enrolls at [[Ichigo Kurosaki]]'s school. During a routine purification of hollows, Ichigo is confronted by Hirako, who shows that he can willingly produce a hollow mask similar to what Ichigo has done unconsciously. He asks Ichigo to join his group, the [[List of Bleach characters#Visoreds|Vizards]]. At the same time, [[List of Bleach characters#Kon|Kon]], in Ichigo's body, is attacked by Grand Fisher, and [[Uryū Ishida]] is attacked by a pair of hollows. Uryū is rescued by his father, [[List of Bleach characters#Ryūken Ishida|Ryūken Ishida]], who reveals that he is a Quincy.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 111
| EpisodeNumber2  = 2
| Title           = Shock! The True Identities of the Fathers
| TranslitTitle   = Kyōgaku! Oyajitachi no Shōtai
| NativeTitle     = 驚愕！親父達の正体
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = [[Motosuke Takahashi]]
| DirectedBy      = Eitarō Ano
| WrittenBy       = [[Michiko Yokote]]
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|1|17}}
| AltDate         = April 19, 2009
| ShortSummary    = After rescuing his son from the arrancar attacking him, Ryūken offers Uryū the opportunity to restore his powers on the condition he never associates with Soul Reapers. Kon continues to flee from the Grand Fisher. Despite receiving help from [[List of Bleach characters#Lirin|Lirin]], [[List of Bleach characters#Kurōdo|Kurōdo]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Noba|Noba]], he is still caught. [[List of Bleach characters#Isshin Kurosaki|Isshin Kurosaki]], Ichigo's father, arrives to save him. Ichigo and Hirako recognize a new presence, and neither can identify that it is Isshin. Before leaving, Ichigo declines Hirako's invitation. The Grand Fisher draws his ''zanpakutō'', transforming into a stronger state, and Isshin, identifying the Grand Fisher as an arrancar, kills him in a single attack, avenging his wife.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 112
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = The Commencement of War, Vizards and the Arrancars
| TranslitTitle   = Tatakai no Hajimari, Vaizādo to Arankaru
| NativeTitle     = 戦いの始まり、仮面の軍勢と破面
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Motosuke Takahashi
| DirectedBy      = Jun'ya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|1|24}}
| AltDate         = May 3, 2009
| ShortSummary    = [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Kisuke Urahara|Kisuke Urahara]] appears and converses with Isshin about the arrancar under the command of former Soul Reaper [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach|captain]] [[Sousuke Aizen]], the Vizards, and explains that the Hōgyoku will take a year to be fully awaken. At school, Hirako asks Ichigo again to join the Vizards, explaining that Ichigo's [[List of Bleach characters#Hollow Ichigo|inner hollow]] will overwhelm him if he does not. Later, Hirako is confronted by [[List of Bleach characters#Hiyori Sarugaki|Hiyori Sarugaki]], another Vizard, who berates him concerning his lack of success in recruiting Ichigo. [[Orihime Inoue]] and [[Yasutora Sado|Yasutora "Chad" Sado]] confront Hirako and Hiyori, and Hirako takes Hiyori away before she can kill Orihime and Chad. Elsewhere, Uryū agrees to Ryūken's proposal.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 113
| EpisodeNumber2  = 4
| Title           = Prelude to the Apocalypse, The Arrancar's Offensive
| TranslitTitle   = Sekai Hōkai e no Jokyoku, Arankaru Shūrai
| NativeTitle     = 世界崩壊への序曲、アランカル襲来！
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Masami Shimoda
| DirectedBy      = Akira Shimizu
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|1|31}}
| AltDate         = May 3, 2009
| ShortSummary    = After his discussion with Hirako, Ichigo realizes that his inner hollow is indeed becoming more than he can control. At home, the voice of his inner hollow taunts him, saying that he will come closer and closer to him until he takes over his body. Meanwhile, two arrancars, [[List of hollows in Bleach#Yammy Riyalgo|Yammy Riyalgo]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Ulquiorra Schiffer|Ulquiorra Schiffer]] arrive in Karakura Town, and Yammy begins to consume the souls of all the humans in the area. Orihime and Chad arrive, and both are easily defeated by Yammy. As he attempts a killing blow against Orihime, Ichigo arrives to block the attack.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 114
| EpisodeNumber2  = 5
| Title           = Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia and Shinigami
| TranslitTitle   = Saikai, Ichigo to Rukia to Shinigami-tachi

| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Kazunori Mizuno
| DirectedBy      = Kazunori Mizuno{{efn|name=penname|Credited under the pen name {{nihongo|"Kumi Hitokuchi"|一口 久美|Hitokuchi Kumi}}.}}
| WrittenBy       = [[Natsuko Takahashi]]
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|2|7}}
| AltDate         = May 10, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo uses his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#bankai|bankai]]'', and Ulquiorra identifies him as the target Aizen sent them to investigate. Ichigo begins to battle Yammy, blocking Yammy's first attack and subsequently cutting off his arm. However, his inner hollow interferes, and Yammy gains the advantage. Urahara and [[List of Bleach characters#Yoruichi Shihōin|Yoruichi Shihōin]] arrive, and Yammy is easily beaten by both of them. Ulquiorra rescues him from an attack from Urahara, and the two return to Hueco Mundo. At Ichigo's school, Ichigo meets a team of Soul Reapers consisting of [[Renji Abarai]], [[Tōshirō Hitsugaya]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Rangiku Matsumoto|Rangiku Matsumoto]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Ikkaku Madarame|Ikkaku Madarame]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Yumichika Ayasegawa|Yumichika Ayasegawa]] and [[Rukia Kuchiki]] dispatched to help Ichigo against the arrancar threats.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist

| Title           = Mission! The Shinigami Have Come

| NativeTitle     = 特命！やってきた死神たち
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|2|14}}
| AltDate         = May 10, 2009
| ShortSummary    = After greeting the team, Ichigo is taken by Rukia to fight a hollow. While Ichigo fights the hollow, Rukia berates his inability to defend his friends, and encourages him to fight his inner hollow. Inspired, Ichigo easily defeats the hollow, and Rukia takes him to Orihime to apologize for not protecting her against the arrancar. At Ichigo's house, Hitsugaya explains Aizen's plans for the arrancars and the different types of hollows. In Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra and Yammy report their findings in the real world to Aizen and an assembly of arrancar.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}

Grimmjow takes a group of five arrancars, Shawlong Qufang, Edorad Leones, Ilfort Grantz, Nakim Greendina and D-Roy Linker, to kill any being with spiritual power in Karakura Town.

Rukia arrives, telling Ichigo to allow her to fight D-Roy. Using the ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'' of her ''zanpakutō'', she easily defeats D-Roy. However, Grimmjow arrives to fight them, and Rukia realizes that his power is vastly superior to D-Roy's. | ShortSummary    = Ikkaku recalls his first encounter with [[Kenpachi Zaraki]] when he was a vagrant in the Rukongai. Kenpachi easily defeated him, and told Ikkaku to consider a respite from death after a fight as luck. After learning that Kenpachi joined the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Gotei Thirteen|Thirteen Court Guard Squads]] as a captain, Ikkaku and Yumichika join Kenpachi's division. When Renji was a member of the eleventh division, Ikkaku trained him, and Renji asked Ikkaku to become a captain after discovering that Ikkaku could use his ''bankai''. Ikkaku refused, citing his desire to fight and die under Kenpachi's command. In the present, Ikkaku defeats Edorad, and Yumichika congratulates him on his victory.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}

| ShortSummary    = Grimmjow is taken back to Hueco Mundo by Kaname Tōsen, who asks Aizen for permission to execute Grimmjow. When Aizen denies his request, Tōsen slices off Grimmjow's arm and incinerates it. However, in a later conversation with [[Gin Ichimaru]], it is implied that Aizen had planned for it to happen. In the real world, Ichigo attempts to find the Visoreds, realizing that his inner hollow has become too powerful to control. Meanwhile, Ishida trains with his father under the Karakura Hospital and Chad requests that Urahara train him. Ichigo finds the Vizards, and fights Hirako, believing he can force Hirako to tell him how to control his inner hollow. Hiyori stops the battle, and dons her hollow mask to fight Ichigo.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}

| ShortSummary    = With her hollow mask, Hiyori overpowers Ichigo, who is unwilling to use either his hollow mask or his ''bankai''. Ichigo's inner hollow surfaces, and the other Vizards restrain him before he can harm Hiyori. Hirako gives Ichigo an exercise to assess how much spiritual energy he has. Hirako renders Ichigo unconscious, and as Ichigo battles his inner hollow in his internal world, his body in the real world begins to transform into a hollow.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}

| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|5|2}}
| AltDate         = June 14, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo battles against his inner hollow for control while the Vizards battle his increasingly berserk body. Ichigo and his inner hollow both use their ''bankai'' and commence fighting. Meanwhile, Ichigo is continually assaulted by inner manifestations of previous enemies, [[Byakuya Kuchiki]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Jin Kariya|Jin Kariya]]. Ichigo's inner hollow overpowers him and breaks his sword, claiming that he has no desire to serve someone with no instinct for battle.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 125
| EpisodeNumber2  = 16
| Title           = Urgent Report! Aizen's Terrifying Plan!
| TranslitTitle   = Kinkyū Hōkoku! Aizen no Osorubeki Keikaku!
| NativeTitle     = 緊急報告！藍染の恐るべき計画
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hiroki Takagi
| DirectedBy      = [[Noriyuki Abe]]
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|5|9}}
| AltDate         = June 14, 2009
| ShortSummary    = After a conversation with a manifestation of [[Kenpachi Zaraki]], Ichigo is able to steal his sword of the hollow and impale him with it, and gains control over his inner hollow. Elsewhere, first division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]] speaks with Hitsugaya concerning Aizen's objective, desiring to use 100,000 human souls in Karakura Town to create a key to the dimension the king of the Soul Society lives in and overthrow the king. At Urahara's shop, Chad is training by fighting against Renji's ''bankai'' as training, and Uryū is training by fighting his father under Karakura Hospital. Meanwhile, Yamamoto tells Hitsugaya that lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Momo Hinamori|Momo Hinamori]] wishes to speak with him.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 126
| EpisodeNumber2  = 17
| Title           = Uryū vs. Ryūken! Clash of the Parent-Child Quincys
| TranslitTitle   = Uryū VS Ryūken! Gekitotsu Kuinshī Oyako
| NativeTitle     = 雨竜VS竜弦！激突クインシー親子
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hodaka Kuramoto<hr>Takeshi Shirai
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto<hr>Takeshi Shirai
| WrittenBy       = Natsuko Takahashi
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|5|16}}
| AltDate         = June 21, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Hinamori appears to still be in a trance, believing that Aizen is innocent and urges Hitsugaya to save him, which angers him. Throughout the town, various training sessions are taking place: Ichigo is training with Hiyori to lengthen the time he can use his hollow mask, Chad is training with Renji to make his arm stronger, and Uryū is training with Ryūken to regain his powers. Meanwhile, Orihime tracks down Ichigo to inform him of Aizen's plans. This comes as a surprise to the other Vizards, as she passes through the barrier with no effort. In his battle with Ryūken, Uryū finally loses his patience and goes on the attack, only to be shot through the chest. A pentacle-shaped scar forms at the point of contact, and Ryūken informs Uryū that his powers have been restored.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 127
| EpisodeNumber2  = 18
| Title           = Urahara's Decision, Orihime's Thoughts
| TranslitTitle   = Urahara no Ketsudan, Orihime no Omoi
| NativeTitle     = 浦原の決断、織姫の想い
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Hiroaki Nishimura
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|5|30}}
| AltDate         = June 21, 2009
| ShortSummary    = With Orihime's attack spirit Tsubaki destroyed by Yammy, Urahara tells Orihime that he does not want her to participate in the upcoming battle against the arrancar. Orihime is saddened by the decision, but understands it. After being taken back to the Vizards by Hiyori, however, the Vizard [[List of Bleach characters#Hachigen "Hachi" Ushōda|Hachigen "Hachi" Ushōda]] is able to restore Tsubaki. Meanwhile, Yammy has his arm reattached by an arrancar surgeon, and Ulquiorra explains that Grimmjow lost his rank as an [[List of hollows in Bleach#Espada|Espada]] when he lost his arm. Yammy is revealed to be the Tenth Espada. Meanwhile Aizen becomes interested in Orihime's powers.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 128
| EpisodeNumber2  = 19
| Title           = The Nightmare Arrancar! Team Hitsugaya Moves Out
| TranslitTitle   = Akumu no Arankaru! Hitsugayatai Shutsugeki
| NativeTitle     = 悪夢のアランカル！日番谷隊出撃
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|6|6}}
| AltDate         = June 28, 2009
| ShortSummary    = During a hollow attack, Rangiku protects the spirit of a child from an arrancar that sings a strange song. After Ikkaku dispatches the arrancar, they forgo sending the child to the Soul Society to interrogate him. The child, named Shōta Toyokawa, is insisitent that he has something to do before leaving the real world, but will not reveal what it is. Rangiku convinces Hitsugaya to wait a day before sending him to the Soul Society. At night, Shōta attempts to steal Rangiku's ''zanpakutō'', but she catches him. He reveals that he has to find someone, but is evasive about who it is. Before Rangiku can press the issue, the arrancar Ikkaku killed reappears.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 129
| EpisodeNumber2  = 20
| Title           = The Swooping Descent of the Dark Emissary! The Propagation of Malice
| TranslitTitle   = Maiorita Yami no Shisha! Zōshoku suru Akui
| NativeTitle     = 舞い降りた闇の使者！増殖する悪意
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Motosuke Takahashi
| DirectedBy      = Yukio Okazaki
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|6|13}}
| AltDate         = June 28, 2009
| ShortSummary    = While tracking the arrancar, Rangiku and Shōta discover that its song can force souls to walk towards it, and that it can multiply itself without limit. A researcher from the twelfth division reveals that another arrancar is creating the copies, explaining their inability to die. The Soul Reapers defeat all of the arrancars, and Shōta finds the person he was searching for, that being his sister Yui. More clones from the arrancar attack, and Yui runs to the park, where Shōta admits that he abandoned her out of fear.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 130
| EpisodeNumber2  = 21
| Title           = The Invisible Enemy! Hitsugaya's Merciless Decision
| TranslitTitle   = Mienai Teki! Hitsugaya, Hijō na Ketsudan
| NativeTitle     = 見えない敵！日番谷、非情な決断
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Jun'ya Koshiba
| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|6|20}}
| AltDate         = July 5, 2009
| ShortSummary    = The arrancar is revealed to be able to disguise itself as the human souls it has devoured. Upon learning of the attack on Yui by the arrancar, Hitsugaya assumes she is one of the copies, and his inability to send her to the Soul Society confirms this. Still unsure, Hitsugaya has the Soul Society track the disguised arrancar while Yui is sealed within a kido barrier. The analysis confirms Yui is one of the clones, and that the arrancar acquired its cloning ability after absorbing her soul (the report suggests she had strong latent spiritual powers as a human). As Yui's brother, Shōta has similar powers, and Yui uses him to break the barrier.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 6
| EpisodeNumber   = 131
| EpisodeNumber2  = 22
| Title           = Rangiku's Tears, the Sorrowful Parting of Brother and Sister
| TranslitTitle   = Rangiku no Namida, Kanashiki Kyōdai no Wakare
| NativeTitle     = 乱菊の涙、哀しき兄妹の別れ
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Makoto Itō
| DirectedBy      = Matsuo Asami
| WrittenBy       = Masashi Sogo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2007|6|27}}
| AltDate         = July 12, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Although Yui is able to resist the arrancar and keep Shōta safe, the original arrancar devours her. It is overpowered by Hitsugaya and Rangiku, but stalls them by claiming that Yui's trapped soul will be destroyed if they kill him. It creates hundreds of arrancar copies to attack the town while it hides. Hitsugaya uses his ''bankai'' in an attempt to find the arrancar by freezing the surroundings. Rangiku and Shōta manage to track the arrancar via the song it sings, and Hitsugaya disables it with his ''bankai''. Rangiku and Shōta defeat the arrancar, releasing all the souls it devoured in the process. With the arrancar gone, Rangiku sends Shōta to the Soul Society to reunite him with his sister.
| LineColor       = 00A987
}}
